title: P-256 sigma rho: metered branchy corrections, blinded prefix chain, register-resident forward block, 2^20-walk batches, flag-carry finishes, eight-copy loops, implicit previous key, small-key adders, checkpoint-only cycles, deferred inv test, paired reduction words, y3 fold with y-window adders

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1 (extended to the small-key y-window adder table), M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail, with the fold model for dy) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.741734 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The walk is the predecessor's (A=2^24, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, residual Markov factor 400000) with tau=0.4943092 and batches of 2^20 walks. Every adder is redrawn from fresh coins until its Montgomery x is below 2^231 and its Montgomery y Y satisfies |2Y-p| <= p>>7 (at most 2^40 trials, worst case charged; a 2-D character-sum count with Bombieri's bound gives at least 2^224-2^160-3 accepted points, so failure stays below 2^-345); the batch forms D=x(W)-x(R) and t=x3-x(W). Two products of one factor share its Montgomery rows B1 = R/2^64, B2 = B1/2^64 (78 instead of 90 instructions each); the forward block also forms Q = dy*PRE and the backward block takes lambda = INV*Q. Cycle detection is checkpoint-only: the 64-round anchor filter catches every cycle of length 2..64, a two-cycle escaping at the next anchor as a charged anchor check, epsilon=196/A+288/A^2+768/A^3. The backward block stores y3 or p-y3 (|y3'-y(W)|, or y3 at a top-limb tie); walk classes, keys and events are unchanged and y3's fix-up runs only at a top-limb tie. Every conditional field correction is a forward branch whose taken fix-up adds its exact extra instructions to a run-wide meter capped after every round at n*CORR+LAMBDA_CAP, CORR=13.959715 per step (site weights, rates and pads as in proof.md). Each global round blinds every batch's prefix chain with one fresh uniform unit rho (charged); the cap's abort probability uses only the algorithm's own coins (per-trail Azuma-Hoeffding with the average premise H-trail, Hoeffding over blinding noise), DELTA_CORR<5.07e-14, and the work bound holds regardless. The base's fixed path is 608,739,081 instructions per 2^20-walk plain round (the y3-fold revision's 629,710,511 less 110(2^20-1) - 90(2^20-2) - 160, with the 1,024 per round allowance), anchor rounds 4*(2^20-1)+9 more, giving the base C_COMMON=580.604623 and step charge 594.650484. The changes below remove 11,814 instructions per plain round and one per lane per anchor round, so PLAIN_FIXED=608,727,267, ANCHOR_EXTRA=3*(2^20-1)+9, C_COMMON=580.577731 and the step charge is 594.599878 against the predecessor's 714.759990. Three value-preserving changes on the shared-rows kernel: (i) `finv` walks p-2 in 4-bit windows (253 squarings, 39 multiplications instead of 255 and 127; the top bit of the 256-bit exponent is absorbed by starting at a^15), saving 11,814 instructions per round; (ii) the anchor cap test is one `tbnz x12,#60`, the same predicate (counter <= 2^60+1), saving one instruction per lane per anchor round; (iii) every unbatched rare-path addition shares `finv`, so F_MAX falls 41,190 -> 29,376 and wL 2,789,697 -> 2,021,787 (65 F_MAX terms), giving two-cycle charge 0.0602549 and reserve 0.0624331. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^81.961192 units, nonuniform advice zero, and the conditional success margin at least 5e-7 above 0.39 (5.557e-7 at tau=0.4943092). Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure, with checkpoint-only cycle detection and the small-key adder key rule at toy scale (adder_key_shift 2: adders redrawn until key < p>>2; shift 4 exceeded the runner's time limit; no y window), at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
